prf.safeParcel: Typed enabled field1 plus field2 concatenated first/optional-second32-byte results; no invented additional parcel field
prf.nativeJson: Nested prf.results.first and optional second base64url outputs; creation enabled result when applicable
prf.hostEvidence: Existing PRF vectors plus private-key migration, full-request hybrid authority/CBOR/builder and account adapter fixtures pass in the full604-case host batch at dece944de3a1457696d929912ffb9f3b4b4bdb84. Both APKs compile; Android parcel fixture is unexecuted.
prf.hybrid: Pinned GMS already-hashed32/64 input forms, exact credential-ID selection, unsigned CTAP make/get outputs6/8; actual authenticated transcript plus full wire/options/RP/hash lease, one-use private bridge, socket/Shutdown cancellation and current account secret authority.

existingBlobReads.implementation: native Credential Manager get only, inside authenticated withSecret owner/caller/RP/account/birthday scope
existingBlobReads.inputs: getCredBlob:true and/or largeBlob:{read:true}; native creation and write forms are implemented separately with complete extension admission.
existingBlobReads.credBlob: Authenticated field3 bytes, empty if absent; signed authenticator-data CBOR before ECDSA and base64url clientExtensionResults.getCredBlob
existingBlobReads.largeBlob: Field4 raw DEFLATE with explicit field5 original/uncompressed size<=2048, bounded compressed input and strict complete-stream/no-trailing/expansion checks; valid data returns largeBlob.blob, absent/invalid data omits the blob result
existingBlobReads.privacy: Temporary full-secret copy and owned derived output buffers cleared; no private-key export or mutation
existingBlobReads.unsupported: No typed legacy GMS FIDO blob fields exist in the pinned reference AuthenticationExtensions ABI (fields2..14); unsupported legacy requests remain unadvertised.
existingBlobReads.hostEvidence: 14 passing pure blob-read tests and 3 native parser/signed-CBOR/JSON tests in source36246827, including valid 2053-byte compressed framing and real encrypted-secret decoding.

passkeyExtensions.remaining: Legacy blobs have no proven typed reference ABI; pinned GMS creates ES256/P256, so non-ES256 is not a source-proven missing capability. Native extension/payment/hybrid implementation is host-tested; provider/device and cross-device acceptance remain pending.

blobWrites.implementation: Native Credential Manager credBlob creation bounded32, largeBlob support and writes bounded2048 using raw DEFLATE; request-bound durable SECRET_UPDATE and authenticated readback precede output.
blobWrites.authority: Immutable passkey identity, device authorization, owner/caller/RP/account/birthday checks and original request digest; writes and PRF migration combine into one mutation.
blobWrites.hostEvidence: Relevant pure and native host fixtures pass in the full604-case batch at dece944de3a1457696d929912ffb9f3b4b4bdb84; product and instrumentation APKs compile. No live provider/device acceptance.
